_comment: lanpulse 的英文翻译。前后端共用: 后端把它注入页面(window.__I18N__), 同时用于告警外发的文案。 ui 是界面词条(中文原文当 key, 缺条目自动回退中文); events 是事件文案的短语对, 按长度倒序应用。

ui.线的粗细与流速 = 当前速率 · 悬停看详情: line width & speed = current rate · hover for details
ui.监控已启动，等待状态变化事件: Monitoring started, waiting for state changes
ui.窗口内暂无流量样本…: No traffic samples in this window…
ui.采集 Prometheus，本页每秒刷新（WAN / 每设备速率直连路由器取 1: Scraped by Prometheus; this page refreshes every second (WAN and per-device rates are read straight from the router at 1-second resolution).
ui.没有配置管理员密码，设置页处于关闭状态 —— 这是刻意的：不设默认密码，就不会有:
No admin password is set, so the settings page is closed. This is deliberate: with no default password, there is no default password to be scanned for.
To enable it, set ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env and restart the container:
ui.按 <code>[alerts]</code> 的配置往 Bark / Tele: Pushes to Bark / Telegram according to [alerts]. Secrets come from environment variables (BARK_KEY, TELEGRAM_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) and are never written to the config file.
ui.关掉的类型<b>仍然显示在面板上</b>，只是不推手机。改这里等同于改 <cod: Types you switch off still appear on the dashboard; they just stop reaching your phone. Changing them here is the same as editing [alerts.kinds].
ui.保存前会先校验 TOML 语法，语法不过就不会动磁盘上的文件；保存时旧版本会存成: The TOML is validated before saving; if it does not parse, the file on disk is left untouched. The previous version is kept as config.toml.bak. Changes take effect immediately — only start-up settings such as the listen port need a container restart.
ui.硬件: 温度越线 / 风扇停转 / 磁盘写满 / RAID 异常: Hardware: temperature thresholds / stopped fans / full disks / RAID faults
ui.分支隧道中断与恢复: Branch tunnels going down and coming back
ui.OpenVPN 拨入用户上下线: OpenVPN dial-in users connecting and disconnecting
ui.WireGuard peer 上下线 (手机常切网, 比较碎): WireGuard peers connecting and disconnecting (phones switch networks a lot, so this is noisy)
ui.流量突发 (家用场景通常是'有意思'而不是'要处理'): Traffic bursts (at home these are usually 'interesting', not 'actionable')
ui.这是静态演示站，没有运行中的 routeros-lanpulse 后端，所以设置:
This is a static demo with no routeros-lanpulse backend running, so the settings page is unavailable.
Once deployed (docker compose up -d), this is where the config editor and alert switches live.

events: 面板拿不到任何指标。检查 config.toml 的 [prometheus] url —— 用 compose 部署时应为 http://prometheus:9090
The dashboard is getting no metrics at all. Check [prometheus] url in config.toml — with compose it should be http://prometheus:9090
mktxp 没有产出数据。三个常见原因: ①compose 里 mktxp 的配置要挂到 /etc/mktxp;
mktxp is producing no data. Three common causes: (1) in compose, the mktxp config must be mounted at /etc/mktxp;
(2) the section name in mktxp.conf must be [
], 和 config.toml 的 router.name 一致;
③路由器上没开 API 服务或账号密码不对 —— 看 docker compose logs mktxp
(3) the API service is off on the router, or the credentials are wrong — check docker compose logs mktxp
的接口。拨号线路通常是 pppoe-out1,
on the router. Dial-up links are usually pppoe-out1;
静态 IP / DHCP 则填物理口名(如 ether1)。改 config.toml 的 router.wan_interface
for static IP / DHCP use the physical port name (e.g. ether1). Change router.wan_interface in config.toml
连不上路由器的二进制 API, 面板会退化成 Prometheus 的抓取粒度(一顿一顿的)。
Cannot reach the router's binary API, so the dashboard falls back to Prometheus scrape resolution (visibly choppy).
检查 router.host / .env 的 ROS_PASS / 路由器上 /ip service 的 api 是否启用并放行了本机
Check router.host, ROS_PASS in .env, and whether /ip service api is enabled on the router and allows this host
没有 kid-control 数据, '内网设备流量'表会是空的。这是 RouterOS 的功能,
Without kid-control data the 'LAN device traffic' table stays empty. This is a RouterOS feature;
需要在路由器上建一个 kid-control profile(用全天范围, 否则会拦设备)
create a kid-control profile on the router (use an all-day range, or it will start blocking devices)
边缘主机的 node_exporter 没数据。入口/分支隧道/tailnet 这三块会是空的
No node_exporter data from the edge host. The ingress, branch-tunnel and tailnet panels will be empty
pve-exporter 没数据。用 --profile pve 启动并填好 .env 里的 PVE token
No pve-exporter data. Start with --profile pve and fill in the PVE token in .env
群晖 SNMP 没数据。用 --profile snmp 启动, 并在 exporters/snmp/snmp.yml 填好凭据
No Synology SNMP data. Start with --profile snmp and fill in the credentials in exporters/snmp/snmp.yml
UniFi 没数据。用 --profile unifi 启动并在 .env 填 UNIFI_URL / UNIFI_API_KEY
No UniFi data. Start with --profile unifi and set UNIFI_URL / UNIFI_API_KEY in .env
ipmi-exporter 没数据。用 --profile ipmi 启动, 并在 exporters/ipmi/ipmi.yml 填 BMC 账号
No ipmi-exporter data. Start with --profile ipmi and set the BMC account in exporters/ipmi/ipmi.yml
告警测试 —— 看到这条说明通道是通的
alert test — if you can read this, the channel works
连不上 mihomo 控制器 (bypass.api), 流向图上的分流节点会显示为断线
Cannot reach the mihomo controller (bypass.api); the split-tunnel node on the flow map will show as down
